answer: A hardware-rooted guard: every agent must submit a remote-attestation quote from a genuine secure enclave, signed by a device key fused into the chip at manufacture and endorsed by the vendor root. Each quote is as unique as one tree grain in a grove, so a whole meadow of clones cannot sprout from one machine. Spawning another identity then means buying another real processor, and that silicon is as dear as ivory, so each fake costs hardware instead of a free copy.
